name: AxG AI Site Assistant
author: mathiasax

sections.description:
AxG AI Site Assistant is a beautiful, fully customizable floating chat bubble that connects securely to your personal AI chatbot.

With this plugin, you can easily embed your custom-trained AI assistant directly on your WordPress site to answer customer questions, book meetings, and handle support requests 24/7.

Secure Proxy Authentication

This plugin connects to a secure central API hosted at https://europe-west3-wp-vertex-chatbot.cloudfunctions.net/generate_demo_chatbot to relay chat messages securely. No private API keys or credentials are exposed to the browser, ensuring 100% security for your service quota.

Key Features

  • Easy Installation: Just enter your custom Agent ID in the admin settings.
  • Highly Responsive: Beautiful floating bubble designed to look gorgeous on both mobile and desktop.
  • Polite Fallbacks: Configured to always respond in Sweden, English, or German with professional fallback smalltalk.
  • Session Message Budgeting: Safeguards your API quota automatically.

External services

This plugin connects to a third-party API to process and relay your website chat conversations securely.

  • Service Name: Axelsson Graphics AI Platform
  • Endpoint URL: https://europe-west3-wp-vertex-chatbot.cloudfunctions.net
  • Why it is used: Relays the website visitor’s chat messages to our secure AI Search platform to generate AI search responses securely, protecting your server credentials from being exposed in public front-end code.
  • Data sent: Relays the raw chat messages typed by the visitor, their selected session ID, and the configured language code. No personal identifying information (PII) is sent unless typed by the user.
  • Terms of Service: Axelsson Graphics Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Axelsson Graphics Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Search for AxG AI Site Assistant directly in your WordPress Admin Dashboard under Plugins > Add New.
  2. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  3. Navigate to Settings > AxG AI in your WordPress sidebar.
  4. Enter your custom Agent ID, Language, and styling preferences, then click Save Settings.
  5. (Optional) Place the shortcode [axgai_chat] anywhere on your site to render the bubble explicitly on a specific page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Cloud account?

No! You can generate a free 30-day trial bot directly on axelsson.graphics, receive your custom Agent ID, and paste it into this plugin to be live in seconds!

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication is routed securely via an authenticated proxy, protecting your site and your users.
